method.pairing: identical task IDs within condition and horizon; base scenarios across horizons
method.ci: percentile bootstrap over paired units, 2000 resamples, seed 0
tests: two-sided exact McNemar on discordant pairs (success differences)
two-sided sign-flip permutation over paired units (interactions and penalties), exact for integer differences
method.interaction_reading: negative interaction = the quantized model loses more at the longer horizon
method.multiple_comparisons: Holm adjustment within each of the three families
limitations: Each task runs once at temperature 0, so within-task sampling variance is not estimated.
Horizon conditions of one base scenario are matched observations, not independent tasks.
